Tax uses **banker's rounding, `decimal.ROUND_HALF_EVEN`**. That comes from a recorded decision made with the finance team in March 2026, which says not to use `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

The code doesn't implement it yet. `tax_for` in `src/billing/tax.py` currently just raises `NotImplementedError`, and nothing else in `src` sets a rounding mode. So the decision is only in the project memory, not in the code. When `tax_for` gets written, it should quantize with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.
